name: Have you completed a Data Protection and Impact Assessment (DPIA)?
conditionsText:
Usually required when:
- Processing personal data
- Introducing new technology
- Conducting large-scale processing
- Monitoring individuals
requirementTitle: Have you completed a Data Protection and Impact Assessment (DPIA)?
requirementDescription: Have you formally assessed how the service affects people's privacy and identified actions needed to protect personal data?
why: A DPIA helps identify privacy risks before a service is implemented and ensures appropriate safeguards are designed into the service from the outset.
